name: Khattam – Image Watermark
author: Ali Malas

sections.description:
Khattam is a powerful and user-friendly WordPress plugin designed to add logo watermarks to your images. It offers multiple methods to apply and manage watermarks, ensuring flexibility and efficiency for website administrators and content creators.

Key Features

  • Automatic Watermarking: Automatically apply your logo to images upon upload
  • Gutenberg Integration: Add watermarks to all images within the current post
  • Individual Image Control: Place or remove the logo on specific images
  • Bulk Actions: Apply or remove watermarks in bulk
  • Customizable Settings:
    • Logo Position: Choose from four corners
    • Logo Size: Specify as percentage of image size
    • Logo Opacity: Adjust transparency level
  • Performance Optimized: Efficient watermarking process
  • Supports Various Image Formats: PNG, JPG, WebP, and GIF
  • Backup & Restore: Keeps original image backup
  • Multilingual Support: Fully supports Arabic
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/khattam directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->Khattam screen to configure the plugin
  4. Upload your logo and configure default settings
sections.faq:
Can I customize the appearance of the watermark beyond position, size, and opacity?

Currently, Khattam allows customization of logo position, size, and opacity. Future updates may include more customization options based on user feedback.

What should I do if the original image is not found when removing a watermark?

Ensure that the original image backup was created successfully. If issues persist, please contact the developer for support.

Does it support all image types?

The plugin supports PNG, JPG, WebP, and GIF formats. Note that animated GIFs are not supported.
